name: User Interface Layout
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/features).
*   Task: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Input Cluster: Front-end refinements (card borders, item separators, product list grids).
*   Raw Items:
    *   PR #1628: Fixes mobile UI layout (missing separators) and refactors border logic (using sibling combinator to prevent double borders above footers).
    *   PR #966: Simplifies markup of order item.
*   Constraint Checklist & Confidence Score:
    1.  Structure for features (Problem, Solution, Impact): Yes.
    2.  Structure for bug fixes (Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]): Yes.
    3.  Simpler is better: Yes.
    4.  Active voice: Yes.
    5.  Granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 for bugs): Yes.
    6.  Tone: Professional, utility-focused: Yes.
    7.  No "AI Slop" (enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust): Yes.
    8.  No Exclamation Points: Yes.
    9.  No dev-time bugs (synthesize as part of feature): Yes.
    10
